en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.815 - Sama’a ibn Mehran asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about wearing a sword during prayer that has glue or leather (adhesive substances, such as glue made from animal parts) on it.
Imam (as) replied: "There is no problem as long as you do not know that it is from a dead (non-slaughtered) animal”.
